stories.title: French luxury stores board up windows ahead of new protests
stories.summary: Luxury retailers in France have boarded up store windows. They are preparing for fresh protests. The report does not name the cities, stores, or the cause of the protests.
stories.whyItMatters: Protests can disrupt sales and store hours in a major luxury retail market. They may also point to wider social or economic strain in France.
whatToWatch: Whether the protests take place and their size
Any impact on luxury retailers' sales or store hours
Statements from retailers or French officials
questions: What is driving the planned protests?
Which stores or cities face the biggest risk?

stories.title: Ukrainian strike on enterprise in Russia's Oryol region kills three, governor says
stories.summary: A Ukrainian strike hit an enterprise in Russia's Oryol region. The regional governor said three people died. Investing.com did not name the enterprise or its industry.
stories.whyItMatters: Strikes on Russian industrial sites add to the war's risk to energy and commodity supply chains that markets track closely.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of the target and any damage to production
Russia's response to the strike
Any move in oil or gas prices tied to the war
questions: Could the strike affect energy or commodity supply?
